decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in  walls of the roof extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 5 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed erection of a pitched roof to  Nos.1-12 and 13-24 Walnut Tree Road, is acceptable as it would enhance the appearance of the site and  not harm the appearance of the area in which it is situated. It would also not have a harmful impact upon the living conditions of neighbours, thus complying with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a pitched roof to flats 1-12 and 13-24 walnut tree road.
